contract.model: static Int32 countdown proof with constant non-negative ingress

supported: static non-generic Int32(Int32) direct and mutual countdown recursion
exactly one recursive edge per SCC method
recursive transition exactly arg0 minus one
arg0 zero terminating path dominates recursive edge
live caller values, locals, RA spills and nested nonrecursive helpers
rejected: recursion without explicit paired V1 depth/stack options
unguarded, non-decrementing, negative or dynamic-ingress recursion
recursive bodies with backedges or multiple recursive edges
multiple recursive SCCs, unsupported signatures and unsupported managed features
depth or post-RA conservative stack bound overflow

qualification.positiveExecution: Direct, mutual, live-value, spill-bearing and nested-helper recursive programs execute to exact results on ISE and restore SP.
qualification.negativeQualification: Default-off, invalid proof shapes and exact one-below depth/stack boundaries reject with stable HCSCF-RECURSION diagnostics.
qualification.determinism: Presented-body permutations produce identical graph/proof/order/object/link/HCEXE outputs; two clean installed-pack publishes are byte-identical.
qualification.nativeAot: Adapter-presented roots/bodies traverse the pinned ILCompiler graph and the single canonical CIL/Core/HCO backend; proof/stack evidence is bound into image and publish provenance.
qualification.changedPathAudit: Passed; compiler CIL/NativeAOT packaging/sample, RefPlan6 plan/evidence and compiler tests only; no ISE/runtime/loader/ISA implementation source changed.

externalBaselineFailures: global.json requests SDK 10.0.201; local deterministic roll-forward resolves SDK 10.0.204 as frozen in Phase 00.
The CIL Release build retains its pre-existing obsolete IrInstructionAnnotation.LegalSlots warning.
HybridCPU_ISE.Tests intentionally forbids Release builds with internal test hooks; qualification tests run in Debug test-support configuration while production compiler projects are built Release.

nextDependencyGate.gate: Any broader recursion shape or default enablement requires a new explicit decision and contract; it is not inferred from this V1 extension.
